clues.text: At Elim, the Israelites camped by twelve springs of water and seventy of these trees.
The prophetess Deborah sat under one named for her, between Ramah and Bethel, to judge Israel.
Solomon carved these, along with cherubim and open flowers, on the temple walls all around.
A psalm says the righteous will flourish like this tree and grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
As Jesus came to Jerusalem, the great crowd took branches of it and went out shouting Hosanna.
John saw a countless multitude in white robes before the throne, holding branches of it in their hands.
Israel was told to gather branches of these trees, with willows of the brook, and rejoice before the LORD seven days.
